feature1.title: On-Device Key Storage
feature1.description: Bearby stores your keys directly on your device, ensuring full control and security without external dependencies.

feature2.title: Zero Data Collection
feature2.description: Bearby collects no user data whatsoever, prioritizing your privacy and autonomy at every step.

feature3.title: Seamless User Experience
feature3.description: Enjoy a smooth and intuitive interface designed for ease of use, backed by robust cryptographic protection.

feature4.title: AES-256 + PBKDF2 + BLAKE3 Encryption
feature4.description: Leverage top-tier encryption with AES-256, PBKDF2, and BLAKE3 for unmatched security of your assets.

feature5.title: Local Transaction Signing
feature5.description: All transactions are signed directly on your hardware, eliminating risks from remote processing.

feature6.title: Advanced Cryptographic Layers
feature6.description: Benefit from multiple layers of cryptography, ensuring secure storage and transfer of your digital assets.
